column1: crime in england and wales: year ending march 2020 - annual supplementary tables

column2: These data tables are published alongside the bulletin Crime in England & Wales: year ending March 2020.
For explanatory notes on these statistics, see the User Guide to Crime Statistics for England and Wales.
Data tables shown in this workbook relate to the Crime Survey for England and Wales (CSEW).

Following a methodological change to the handling of repeat victimisation in the CSEW, these data are not comparable with data published before January 2019. For more information see Improving victimisation estimates derived from the Crime Survey for England and Wales.

Fieldwork for the year to March 2020 was suspended two weeks early on Wednesday the 18th March 2020 just prior to the lockdown restrictions being announced by the Government on the 23rd March 2020. Estimates for the year to March were therefore unaffected by the lockdown restrictions.
